# opalstack_psqldb (Data Source)

Looks up a PostgreSQL database by `id` or by `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opalstack_psqldb" "wiki" {
  name = "wiki"
}

output "wiki_users" {
  value = data.opalstack_psqldb.wiki.user_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) UUID of the database.
- `name` (String) Name of the database.

### Read-Only

- `charset` (String) Character set of the database.
- `readonly_user_ids` (Set of String) UUIDs of the PostgreSQL users that may only read.
- `server_id` (String) UUID of the server the database lives on.
- `user_ids` (Set of String) UUIDs of the PostgreSQL users that may read and write.
